warnings: the DFU state is 8 (dfuMANIFEST-WAIT-RESET), not dfuIDLE. A DNLOAD that starts a *fresh* download is expected only in dfuIDLE; in any other state the ROM may append at an offset the host cannot see. If the first exchange fails, that is the first hypothesis to exclude, and a bus reset (`a9boot reset is Lead-only`) is the way back to dfuIDLE — not a retry.
